entities.summary: Guzal Ramazanovna Sitdykowa is a Bashkir writer, poet, publicist and translator. She is a member of the Union of Writers of Russia and the Union of Writers of Bashkortostan. She was the leader of the Society of Bashkir Women of the Republic Bashkortostan from 2004 until 2011. Since 2012, she participates in the international volunteer movement Wikimedia.
